From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Quick recap + training-on-customer-data opt-out (Acme Health)

Hi Sam / Dana —

Thanks again for the call earlier — good to meet the Acme Health team. Short recap and next steps below: 

- Use case: clinical document summarization + triage for the nurse intake team.
- Traffic profile: spikes during 8am–11am PT; latency target ~400ms p95.
- Data handling ask: no training on customer data, strict PII handling, 30-day retention for logs unless flagged for incident response, data residency in us-east-1.

Attached is our standard training-opt-out form that formalizes the "no training" request and outlines logging/data-retention controls. Could you sign and return? I also attached a snapshot of our SOC 2 evidence for your security team to review.

Next steps (proposed):
1) You sign the attached opt-out form and confirm any additional constraints (e.g., IP allowlist, VPC peering timing).
2) We’ll lock the model serving config (no learning/safety-tuning on customer inputs) and provide the audit log configuration for your security review.
3) Pilot kickoff: target week of Nov 29 (subject to signed docs).

Please let me know if anything above is incorrect.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: training-opt-out-form.pdf (1 page)
Attachment: acmehealth-soc2-snapshot.pdf (3 pages)

From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@acmehealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dana Liu <dana.liu@acmehealth.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 09:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Quick recap + training-on-customer-data opt-out (Acme Health)

Thanks Olga — appreciate the clear recap. A couple quick confirmations from our side: 

- We confirm Acme Health requires that Redwood does NOT use any customer-provided content to further train or improve models (opt-out from training).
- Data residency: all production inference and logs must be in us-east-1.
- Logs: we need request/response logs for troubleshooting, but retention should be limited to 30 days by default. If needed for security investigations we understand you can preserve for a longer window with our approval.

I signed the training-opt-out PDF and attached it here (signed copy). Could you confirm the following are implemented on your side before pilot kickoff:
1) Explicit flag in the tenant configuration to disable training-on-customer-data.
2) Retention policy set to 30 days for logs with an on-demand preservation workflow.
3) Confirmation that PII redaction hooks are enabled server-side for any generated artifacts (we discussed deterministic redaction for IDs).

If you can confirm those items in email, we’ll route to our security team (security@acmehealth.com) for final review.

Best,
Sam
Sam Patel
Director of Product, Acme Health
sam.patel@acmehealth.com

Subject: Re: Quick recap + training-on-customer-data opt-out (Acme Health)

Hi Sam —

Thanks for the signed copy, and thanks for surfacing the checklist items. Confirmations below: 

1) Training-on-customer-data: We have an account-level configuration flag that prevents any customer-provided inputs from being used for model training or improvement. For Acme Health we will set that flag immediately upon receiving the signed form.

2) Retention & preservation workflow: Audit logs (request metadata + hashed response references) will be retained for 30 days by default. We have an on-demand preservation process: if you escalate to security@acmehealth.com with a signed preservation request, we can lock and extend retention for a specified investigation window. We will include the preservation runbook in the security handoff.

3) PII handling: Server-side redaction hooks are enabled for standard PHI/PII patterns (SSNs, MRNs, full credit card numbers). For deterministic redaction of custom IDs, we can add a post-processing rule scoped to your tenant.

4) Data residency: All production inference and logs for this tenant will be pinned to us-east-1 (AWS account + region).

I’ve uploaded the signed opt-out to our contract system and attached a copy here. Rishi — I’m looping you in for any contractual or billing items (we discussed a short pilot credit).

Sam/Dana — once you confirm the preservation runbook looks good we’ll schedule the security handoff call.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: signed-training-opt-out.pdf
Attachment: preservation-runbook-link.txt (internal drive link)
